description: This file defines the SeoUrl class responsible for handling SEO URL rewriting and decoding in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages URL parsing, SEO regex matching, and URL rewriting logic as part of the startup process.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: A controller class responsible for decoding SEO URLs into internal route parameters and rewriting URLs into SEO-friendly format within Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Decodes incoming SEO URLs into route parameters based on stored regex and URL mappings, or defaults to error or default actions if URL is invalid.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Converts a standard URL into an SEO-friendly URL using regex, database lookups, and URL path restructuring strategies.
